title: How is Hitler connected to Buddy?
description: Six real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Buddy the Unicorn, through Subhas Chandra Bose, Jawaharlal Nehru, the Dalai Lama, Barack Obama and Buddy's own voice, Keegan-Michael Key.
hook: How's Hitler linked to Buddy the Unicorn?
fun_fact: At their only meeting in 1942, Hitler agreed to arrange a submarine for Subhas Chandra Bose, and in 1943 Bose sailed on a German U-boat, switching to a Japanese submarine off Madagascar.
research_note: King Carol II's 1938 visit to Hitler survives only in watermarked agency prints, so the chain leaves Hitler through Subhas Chandra Bose, and the Dalai Lama carries Nehru's India to Obama's White House without the usual Queen Elizabeth hop.

image.file: File:Subhas Chandra Bose meeting Adolf Hitler.jpg

links.line: In 1942, Hitler shook hands with Indian nationalist Subhas Chandra Bose.

image.file: File:Subhas Chandra Bose, Jawaharlal Nehru and others proceeding to the AICC meeting on October 1937.jpg

links.line: In 1937, Bose walked to a Congress meeting with Jawaharlal Nehru.

image.file: File:The Dalai Lama, Nehru and Zhou Enlai in 1956 in India.jpg

links.line: In 1956, Nehru, now prime minister, welcomed a young Dalai Lama to Delhi.

image.file: File:Barack Obama and the Dalai Lama in 2014.jpg

links.line: In 2014, the Dalai Lama visited Barack Obama at the White House.

image.file: File:Barack Obama and Keegan-Michael Key at White House Correspondents' Association Dinner 2015.jpg

links.line: In 2015, Obama brought out Keegan-Michael Key as his anger translator, Luther.

image.credit: Dia Dipasupil / Getty Images (via Sundance Institute)

links.line: And in 2026, Key posed at Sundance beside the unicorn he voices, Buddy.

where.place: Library Center Theatre, Park City, Utah
